tones.as_spoken: Keep the speaker's own words and register; only remove fillers and fix punctuation.
tones.formal: Complete sentences and standard punctuation. Write gonna or wanna as going to or want to, and leave out chatty openers like yeah or so.
tones.casual: Relaxed and natural, contractions are fine.
tones.very_casual: Like a quick text message: lower case is fine, no final period.
